children: Associated Banc-Corp furnished its Third Quarter 2026 investor presentation highlighting ANB integration on track and sustained growth momentum.
Filed investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) to be used with investors and analysts under Regulation FD.
American National integration progressing; conversion expected in October 2026, with anticipated benefits and risks disclosed.
Reports continued organic growth: stronger deposits, loans and improved margins and returns through YTD Jun 2026.
Updated FY 2026 outlook unchanged: loans, deposits, NII, noninterest income/expense and CET1 targets remain as previously guided.
Strategic priorities for 2027–2029 focus on household/deposit growth, balance sheet remix, margin expansion and disciplined credit/risk management.
